# AnkurAI - Ankur Srivastava

> Independent AI Engineer (IIT Roorkee) building HireIQ AI Interview Agent, Document Intelligence, RAG systems & Agentic AI workflows. Production systems for state governments and US B2B. Corporate Trainer: FDE, Agentic AI, GenAI, Python, Business Development, Email Automation.

## Who is Ankur Srivastava?

Ankur Srivastava, also known as AnkurAI, is an independent AI Engineer based in Ghaziabad, India, alumnus of IIT Roorkee. He builds production AI systems: HireIQ AI Interview Agent (70% faster hiring), Document Intelligence (17+ doc types, 95%+ accuracy), Multilingual RAG over government schemes with WhatsApp bot for Panchayati Raj Dept and Odisha State Dept, and Agentic workflows for US freight brokerage and trades business.

## Products

- **HireIQ AI Interview Agent**: Conducts 15-min structured voice+video interviews in Hindi + English, custom rubrics, cheat detection, ATS integration. Reduces screening time by 70%, enables 24/7 interviewing. White-label available. Book demo at https://ankurai.tech/#contact
- **Document Intelligence**: Azure Document Intelligence + Surya OCR pipeline parsing 17+ govt doc types into structured verified data with 95%+ accuracy. Reduces review from 3 days to 30 minutes.
- **RAG & Conversational AI**: Multilingual RAG, Text-to-SQL, hybrid MMR retrieval, WhatsApp + web + voice assistants grounded in docs.

## Corporate Training

Trainer Ankur Srivastava provides corporate training in India: FDE Training, Agentic AI Training (LangGraph), Generative AI Training, Python Training Ghaziabad, Business Development with AI, Email Automation with Gmail API + AI. Available Online, Offline Delhi NCR, Hybrid.

No Hindi support.</p></div><div><b>The Solution by Ankur Srivastava</b><p class="muted">HireIQ AI conducts human-like interviews via link/phone in Hindi + English, scores on your custom rubrics, auto-rejects or moves forward to ATS.</p></div></div><div style="margin-top:16px" class="grid3"><span class="tag">✓ Voice + Video interviews</span><span class="tag">✓ Hindi + English</span><span class="tag">✓ Custom rubrics</span><span class="tag">✓ Cheat detection</span><span class="tag">✓ ATS integration</span><span class="tag">✓ Instant reports</span></div><h4 style="margin-top:24px">How HireIQ Works — Built by IIT Roorkee AI Engineer</h4><ol style="font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)"><li>Candidate gets interview link via WhatsApp/Email from HireIQ</li><li>AI conducts 15-min structured interview — HireIQ asks role-specific questions</li><li>Transcript + audio + video captured by HireIQ</li><li>LLM scores candidate against your rubric (Technical, Communication, Problem Solving)</li><li>Report pushed to your ATS / Google Sheet / Email automatically</li><li>You interview only top 20% — 70% faster hiring</li></ol><p style="margin-top:16px"><b>Result:</b> 70% reduction in screening time, 3x more candidates screened, consistent scoring.
